name: design-leaders-pack
description: Claude for Design Leaders: 32 Claude Skills to frame, explain, defend and prove design work, and to grow a team and a career. Map the stakeholders and decision rights, interview them, write the problem framing brief and design's strategy on one page. Settle taste arguments with design principles, real options and trade-offs, one DACI approver, a rationale doc and a dated decision log. Pre-wire the review, run it off a deck that asks for a decision, sort conflicting notes in a feedback log, and push back on a harmful request with evidence. Write the quality bar, the critique ritual, the session brief, and turn crit notes into actions. Agree HEART metrics up front, write the impact write-up from real data, keep a UX debt register and build the investment case. Then lead: UX maturity, the team's operating rhythm, a delegation board, a structured hiring loop, a designer's 30-60-90, SBI feedback prep. Then grow: your first 90 days as a lead, the staff path map, a brag document, the promotion case and a leadership case study. For senior, staff and principal designers, design leads, design managers and heads of design. Claude drafts from your real work and real data: it never invents a metric, a user quote or a stakeholder's view, and it never rates a designer or a candidate.
